verdict.rationale: Supabase documents that every project is a full Postgres relational database, which is where joins, constraints and transactions come from. The docs also cover direct SQL execution via `execute_sql`/`apply_migration` and SQL-level features like RLS policies and full-text search. Community users corroborate it as a hosted SQL offering. One user notes PostgREST limitations pushed them back to an API server, but this is vague and does not concretely contradict relational querying. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of join syntax (SQL or API-level embedding), constraint definitions and transaction handling (including via the auto-generated REST API), and hands-on corroboration of transactional behavior.
